title: Static Open-Turret-Shell Unequal-Claw Hermit Crab
description: One newly authored complete stylised hermit-crab-like animal in a fixed grounded pose. A compact high asymmetric tapering shell with broad rounded shoulders and low integral spiral growth relief ends in a broad lower-front thick aperture with a real blind cavity. The narrow crustacean forebody emerges at this aperture; two stalked eyes, four long bent grounded walking legs and two differently sized whole notched pincers define the exposed front. Shell and every animal part are new whole geometry: not the old solid snail relief shell attached to the old wide eight-legged crab, and not the old flat-coiled nautilus hood/tentacles. One model zero scenes, no copied visible meshes. Artistic external silhouette only; no exact species, internal anatomy, living suitability, shell exchange, locomotion, rig, animation, gripping or safety claim.
